requirements.quote:
If TLS experiences an error, it generates an appropriate alert as
   defined in Section 6 of [TLS13].
requirements.condition: When the TLS component experiences an error
requirements.required_behavior: Generate the TLS alert appropriate to that error under TLS 1.3.
requirements.error_behavior: Emit the appropriate alert defined by Section 6 of TLS 1.3.
requirements.why_checkable: Fault-injection tests can trigger defined TLS errors and compare the generated alert with the TLS 1.3 error-to-alert mapping.

requirements.quote: A TLS alert is converted into a QUIC connection error.
requirements.condition: When QUIC receives an alert from its TLS component
requirements.required_behavior: Convert the TLS alert into a QUIC connection error.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Handle the TLS alert without producing the corresponding QUIC connection error.
requirements.error_behavior: Fail the QUIC connection rather than treating the TLS alert as a non-connection error.
requirements.why_checkable: A TLS-alert injection test can observe whether the QUIC endpoint transitions to a connection-error path.

requirements.quote:
The
   AlertDescription value is added to 0x0100 to produce a QUIC error
   code from the range reserved for CRYPTO_ERROR
requirements.condition: When converting a specific TLS alert into a QUIC error code
requirements.required_behavior: Compute the QUIC error code as 0x0100 plus the TLS AlertDescription value.
requirements.error_behavior: Use the resulting code in the CRYPTO_ERROR-reserved range.
requirements.why_checkable: For every AlertDescription input, the emitted numeric code can be compared directly with 0x0100 + AlertDescription.

requirements.quote:
The resulting value is sent in a QUIC
   CONNECTION_CLOSE frame of type 0x1c.
requirements.condition: When sending the QUIC connection error produced from a TLS alert
requirements.required_behavior: Send the resulting error value in a QUIC CONNECTION_CLOSE frame of type 0x1c.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Encode the resulting alert error in a different CONNECTION_CLOSE frame type.
requirements.error_behavior: Carry the mapped CRYPTO_ERROR code in the type-0x1c CONNECTION_CLOSE frame.
requirements.why_checkable: The emitted closing packet can be decoded to verify both the 0x1c frame type and its error-code field.

requirements.quote:
a QUIC endpoint
   MUST treat any alert from TLS as if it were at the "fatal" level.
requirements.condition: When a QUIC endpoint receives any TLS alert, regardless of the alert's stated level
requirements.required_behavior: Treat the alert as a fatal-level alert.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Process a TLS alert as a warning-level, nonfatal alert.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can inject alerts labeled fatal and warning and verify that both follow the same fatal connection-error path.
